description: This Java class 'OpenAPISerialiser' serializes OpenAPI definitions to JSON strings, retrieves specific operations from OpenAPI specs, and handles server URL processing with variables. It is part of the 'org.mockserver.openapi' package.

classes.name: OpenAPISerialiser
classes.description: A class for serializing OpenAPI definitions, retrieving operations, and processing server URLs with variables.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Serializes an OpenAPIDefinition to a JSON string, either the full spec or a specific operation.

methods.name: serverUrlWithVariablesExpanded
methods.description: Expands server URL variables into their default values.

methods.name: firstValidServerPath
methods.description: Returns the first valid server path from multiple server lists, with URL normalization.

methods.name: retrieveOperation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific operation from an OpenAPI spec by operationId.

methods.name: retrieveOperations
methods.description: Retrieves all operations matching a given operationId from an OpenAPI object, with server path prefixing.
